name: media-offload-for-bunny
description: Offload media files to Bunny Storage and stream videos from Bunny Stream via the WordPress Media Library.

scripts.make-build: npm run clean && mkdir -p media-offload-for-bunny-build && rsync -av --exclude-from=.distignore . media-offload-for-bunny-build/
scripts.package: npm run make-build && cd media-offload-for-bunny-build && zip -r ../media-offload-for-bunny.zip . && cd .. && rm -rf media-offload-for-bunny-build
